description: This Java source file defines a custom HTML sanitization policy named 'CustomSafePolicy', which uses the OWASP HTML PolicyBuilder to specify allowed HTML tags and attributes for sanitizing user input, inspired by the Slashdot and AntiSamy policies.

classes.name: CustomSafePolicy
classes.description: A class that implements a custom HTML sanitization policy, providing a static final PolicyFactory for sanitizing HTML content.
